if [ -d "build" ]; then
    echo "clean the build directory"
    rm -rf build/*
    echo "Done!"
fi

if [ ! -d "build" ]; then
    echo "build the build directory"
    mkdir -p build
    echo "Done!"
fi


cd ./build
cmake ..
make -j4
cd ..
cd ./bin
# rm *.txt
mkdir -p Containers
mkdir -p restoreFile
mkdir -p mTarFile
# Check if "./bin/Containers" directory exists and clear its content
if [ -d "Containers" ]; then
    echo "clean the Containers directory"
    rm -rf Containers/*
    echo "Done!"
fi

if [ -d "restoreFile" ]; then
    echo "clean the Containers directory"
    rm -rf restoreFile/*
    echo "Done!"
fi
